div.p: This case-sensitive code system http://example.org/fhir/siu2fhir-au/CodeSystem/siu2fhir-tag defines the following code:

tr.td: Created from an SIU message because no matching resource existed on the FHIR server. Expected to be curated (name, address, identifiers) by an administrator; the service never overwrites it.

description.value: Tags (meta.tag) the ingestion service puts on resources it creates.
